critical_regressions: treating outdated active handoff as current task
restoration-only action vocabulary for unrelated new problem
algorithm-first fallback that ignores original information question

comments: Examples express desired scientific behavior, not a mandatory algorithm, stage sequence, literature veto or claim that paired evaluations were run.
evaluation_input_rule: During a paired agent evaluation, give the candidate agent only case.user_input and the same permitted repository/source context. Keep route/expected/anti_pattern as reviewer-side criteria; never pass the answer key as part of the candidate prompt.
